description: A component in the request pipeline that receives the `HttpContext`, can act before and after calling the next component, or can end the request.
The delegate type `Task (HttpContext)` that represents the rest of the pipeline and is passed to middleware as `next`.
Ending the request in a middleware by not calling `next`, so later middleware and the endpoint never run.
Middleware added with `Run` that has no `next` and always ends its branch of the pipeline.
The order of the `Use...` calls in `Program.cs`, which is the order requests flow in and the reverse of the order responses flow out.
A callback that runs just before response headers are sent, the safe place to add headers from middleware that runs after `next`.
The interface for factory-based middleware, registered in DI and activated per request, so scoped services can be constructor-injected.
